messages:
Ravi Nair: Quick sync — we27re planning to soft-deprecate header-based v1 routing next week. Need alignment on the compatibility shim, console affordances, telemetry keys, and rollout cadence before we flip the default.

Maria Chen: Soft-deprecate = what exactly? Are we auto-switching clients, or only showing warnings? Timeline?

Ravi Nair: Soft = server prefers v2 but will keep a short-term compatibility shim for v1 clients. UX: console banner + per-org toggle to keep legacy behavior for a short window. Telemetry: emit `legacy_header_seen`. Suggested cadence: 2-week canary -> 4-week ramp -> 30-day opt-out grace.

Alex Ortiz: Implementation note: many SDKs send `X-Client-Version: v1`. If we change default routing to v2 we must avoid hard failures. Options: require an explicit compat header like `x-client-compat: legacy`, or honor a console-level "compat pin" per org. Prefer the latter for orgs that need stability.

Dana Liu: Console UX idea: add a row in the Rollouts table for each org: columns [Current route, Last legacy header seen, Keep v1 toggle (30d)]. Add an expandable migration helper with sample shim snippets.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled to canary cluster Tue 03:00 UTC. Watch metrics: `legacy_header_seen`, `compat_fallback_count`, `compat_routing_rate`.

Jeff Kramer: Telemetry requirements: counters `legacy_header_seen`, `compat_fallback_used`, and a latency-delta histogram (p50/p95) comparing requests routed native v2 vs shim-v1. Also track 4xx rate; page if 4xx > 1% for more than 10m.

Ravi Nair: Add trace annotation `compat_decision=shim|native` and `original_client_version=v1|v2` when header present. No user PII.

Alex Ortiz: Pseudocode for router (handshake-only header evaluation):

```
// router pseudocode
const clientVer = req.headers['x-client-version'] // optional
const compatHint = req.headers['x-client-compat'] || orgSettings[org].compat_pin
if (compatHint === 'legacy' && clientVer === 'v1') route('v1')
else route('v2')
emitMetric('compat_decision', { decision: compatHint ? 'shim' : 'native' })
```

Alex Ortiz: Note: we only evaluate headers at connection handshake. Streaming mid-connection header changes are ignored.

Dana Liu: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/243 opened. Includes migration steps, sample middleware, and recommended client library changes. Adding a short snippet for DevEx kits.

Maria Chen: Customer comms: product will prepare a short blog post and a console modal explaining the timeline and how to keep v1 where necessary. Dana — can you draft the modal copy? Keep friction minimal.

Jeff Kramer: Billing check: if a v1 client gets routed to v2, billing stays on the same token accounting but include `original_client_version` tag on usage records so customers can filter. Flag if pipeline cannot accept extra tag.

Ravi Nair: Confirmed: billing logic unchanged. Action items:
- Alex: implement router changes + trace/metric tags (target: EOD Fri)
- Dana: console toggle UX + modal copy + docs updates
- SRE Team: dashboard + alerts for canary/ramp
- Maria/Product: customer comms + org mapping for legacy users
- Jeff/Billing Infra: validate usage tagging accepts `original_client_version`

Jeff Kramer: I27ll validate tagging pipeline and report back. Also create a dashboard that slices by `original_client_version`.

Alex Ortiz: Edge-case: some proxies (eg old API gateways) strip unknown headers. In those cases fallback to org pin.

Maria Chen: I will run a query to find orgs with recent traffic that looks like v1 and include them in a targeted comms list.

Ravi Nair: Thanks all. Keep this thread for rollout notes and any unexpected compatibility failures. Ping here before flipping defaults. :thumbsup:
